description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component used to display log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log entries and displays them in the UI, supporting log chaining and thread-safe UI updates.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for logging output that implements the LogNode interface and formats log messages for display, supporting log chaining.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView initializing with different context and attribute parameters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, handling different log levels, exceptions, and ensuring thread-safe updates to the UI.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Gets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new log line in the LogView.
